title: ChartGPU: A Beautiful WebGPU charting library, let your browser render millions of points smoothly
description:
ChartGPU just threw your entire dataset straight at the GPU and said "deal with it." While every other charting library is choking on a few thousand data points, this thing's handling tens of thousands without breaking a sweat. Line charts, candlesticks, scatter plots—all running buttery smooth because it's using WebGPU instead of making your poor CPU do all the work. Three lines of code and you're done. Built-in zoom, tooltips, crosshairs.

https://github.com/ChartGPU/ChartGPU

#github #opensource
